blocks.prompt: 12 An amount of Rs. 2000 becomes 3320.12 under continuous compounding at 6% per annum. Find the time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh continuous compound interest ka ulta sawal hai: raqam di hui hai aur waqt poocha hai.
Diya kya hai? \(P = 2000\), \(A = 3320.12\), rate 6% saalana, continuous compounding.
Find kya karna hai? Waqt \(t\), jo \(e^{0.06t}\) ki power mein hai.
Rule kaunsa? \(A = Pe^{rt}\), aur power se \(t\) nikalne ke liye \(\ln\).
Plan: values rakhna, 2000 se divide, \(\ln\) lena, aur 0.06 se divide karna. Aakhir mein answer key se milayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P = 2000\), \(A = 3320.12\), \(r = 0.06\).
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\) (saal).
Tareeqa: \(A = Pe^{rt}\) mein values rakh kar \(e^{0.06t}\) ko akela karenge, phir \(\ln\) se \(t\) neeche layenge.

Values rakhein
\[3320.12 = 2000e^{0.06t}\]
Kyun: continuous compounding ka model, di hui values ke saath.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[e^{0.06t} = \dfrac{3320.12}{2000}\]
\[= 1.66006\]
Kyun: dono taraf 2000 se divide kiya.

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[0.06t = \ln(1.66006)\]
\[= 0.506854\]
Kyun: \(\ln(e^{0.06t}) = 0.06t\). Calculator se \(\ln 1.66006 = 0.506854\).
Dhyan dein: yahan \(\log\) (base 10) le liya aur \(e\) ko ignore kar diya to jawab ghalat aayega; base \(e\) ke saath \(\ln\) hi chalta hai.

\(t\) nikaalein
\[t = \dfrac{0.506854}{0.06}\]
\[\approx 8.45\]
Kyun: dono taraf 0.06 se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[2000e^{0.06 \times 8.4476} = 2000e^{0.506854}\]
\[\approx 2000 \times 1.66006 = 3320.12 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab rakhne se wohi raqam wapas aayi. Answer key ki value 8.42 rakhein to \(2000e^{0.06 \times 8.42} \approx 3314.63\) aata hai, jo 3320.12 nahi; is liye 8.45 hi sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(t \approx 8.42\) saal likha hai, jo ghalat hai. \(t = 8.42\) rakhein to raqam \(2000e^{0.06 \times 8.42} \approx\) Rs. 3314.63 banti hai, Rs. 3320.12 nahi. Sahi jawab \(t = \frac{\ln 1.66006}{0.06} \approx 8.45\) saal hai.
